description:
Download videos from YouTube

There are so many interesting things to be found on YouTube, but you can't download the videos or save them as audio files by default. That's why we developed YouTube Video Downloader. This app will help you to accomplish video downloads quickly and without hangups. With our program you can simply download the whole playlist or YouTube channel at once and watch it whenever and wherever you want.
- [CRITICAL] fixed a bug when only 360p was available for some YouTube videos
- [CRITICAL] fixed updates that were downloaded but never installed
- added export of the download history to CSV or JSON
- added 2K and 4K quality for Vimeo
- added tags and cover art for webm and mkv files
- added support for YouTube series and playlist links from a video list
- fixed links copied from Google search results
- fixed download from VK, TikTok and Instagram
- fixed download from Rumble, including channel pages
- fixed a wrong 'DRM protected' message for some YouTube videos
- fixed 'conversion failed' error when there is not enough free space on the disk
- fixed chapter titles appearing in a wrong language
- fixed settings changing by themselves when scrolling in Preferences
- fixed previously downloaded videos disappearing from the list
- fixed slow parallel downloads when the speed limit is on
- fixed endless 'loading info' state
- fixed a crash when Vimeo asked for a captcha
- fixed a crash when removing a video from the list
- fixed window size and position not being remembered
- fixed the app not quitting and staying in the tray
- fixed missing answer when checking for updates manually
- fixed broken text in the Arabic and Chinese interface
- [mac] fixed errors when adding downloads to the Music app
- [win] fixed notifications overwriting each other when several downloads finish at once
- improved the download history window
- improved interface translations
- minor improvements for stability
